description: Angular component for a shape fill image settings panel, managing form controls and user interactions for shape fill image configuration in a map widget.

classes.name: ShapeFillImageSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring shape fill image settings in a map widget.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: applyShapeFillImageSettings
methods.description: Emits the current form values as settings and hides the popover.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the selected shape fill image type.
